data.name: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World
data.detailed_description:
Primordial Chaos, Humanity's Last Stand

The world has just been born, and order has yet to be written. In this cataclysm of creation, it was not humanity that rose first — it was the endless demonic beasts. They hoard the sacred mountains, monopolize the spiritual veins, and have turned the entire world into a hunting ground ruled by tooth and claw. Humanity is nothing more than the most insignificant prey.

You are not the chosen one. You are just a cultivator born into chaos. Ahead of you, countless cultivators have charged forward wave after wave, offering their bodies to prove the Dao — carving trails of blood through the claws of demons with nothing but flesh and bone. Behind you stand countless others just like you, yearning for a patch of land where they can simply live in peace.

Your Dao, Your Path

Primordial Cultivation World is a top-down 2D cultivation RPG with open-world exploration. Scattered story quests will point you in the right direction, but no one can tell you where to go. There is no predetermined destiny — the world is vast, and every step you take writes your own cultivation legend.

The core loop is simple and addictive:

Explore the wilds → Slay demonic beasts → Seize spirit veins → Cultivate in seclusion → Break through → Seize even greater territory

Every breakthrough carries you further, and every sacred mountain is earned through blood and steel.

Key Features

  • A truly open Honghuang world — 2D top-down, large-map combat, vast seamless map with no invisible walls, no fixed routes. Mountains and rivers, hidden caves and blessed sanctuaries — go where you will. If you can survive the journey.

  • Fight to grow, grow to fight — Sacred mountains don't appear out of thin air; they are torn from the jaws of demons. Every spiritual vein you seize accelerates your cultivation. Every resource point you capture sharpens your combat prowess. Every inch of land is paid for in blood.

  • Classic cultivation realms — Qi Refining → Foundation Establishment → Golden Core → Nascent Soul → Spirit Transformation. Break through layer by layer, ascend step by step. Each realm crossed is a rebirth of body and soul. The weak look up in awe; the strong crush all beneath them. This is the law of Honghuang.

  • A brutal primordial ecosystem — Every region is ruled by different demon factions with distinct power levels. Wander into high-level territory unprepared, and you will die. Challenge a beast beyond your realm before you are ready, and you will die. This is not a fairy tale. This is Honghuang.

  • Dual endings, dual destinies — The path of cultivation has more than one destination. Sainthood (成圣): Choose to remain in this land, guard the borders of humanity, and hold the line against demons from beyond — worshipped for eternity by generations to come. Immortality (成仙): Transcend the Spirit Transformation realm, ascend to the upper world, and pursue the ultimate Dao beyond the heavens. Two paths, two endings. The future of Honghuang is yours to decide.

data.short_description: At the dawn of creation, demons rule and humanity faces extinction. Seize sacred mountains, claim spirit veins, carve a path to immortality — win a homeland for humankind. *Primordial Cultivation World*: a top-down 2D open-world combat RPG. Explore, slay, seize, breakthrough — reshape Honghuang.

English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 10 / 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: I3-8100 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 独立显卡, GTX 750 Ti 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
